# SAFEta

> SAFEta provides sexual assault response training, technical assistance, and resources for Sexual Assault Nurse Examiners (SANEs) and forensic healthcare professionals.

SAFEta (Sexual Assault Forensic Examiner Technical Assistance) is a comprehensive resource center supporting healthcare providers, law enforcement, and victim advocates in delivering trauma-informed sexual assault response and forensic examination services. The organization offers webinar training, capacity-building initiatives, and specialized guidance on medical-forensic care, strangulation assessment, and support for underserved communities including Deaf survivors.

## Key Topics

- Sexual Assault Nurse Examiner (SANE)
- Forensic Nursing
- Medical-Forensic Care
- Sexual Assault Response
- Victim Support
- Technical Assistance
- Training Resources
- Strangulation Assessment
- Traumatic Brain Injury
- Deaf Community Support
- Intimate Partner Violence
- Community Capacity Building
- SANE-A
- SANE-P
- Office On Violence Against Women
